requirements_summary: Workload: in-app onboarding copilot (guided flows) — short multi-step dialogues, heavy tool calling to user account APIs
Latency SLO: p95 < 400ms end-to-end for single-turn, streaming start < 150ms desirable
Throughput: typical concurrency 100-250 concurrent users during peaks, burst up to 1k for product launches
Token/cost constraints: strict per-user token caps (configurable per flow), target cost per MAU <$0.10/month incremental
Model prefs: open-model first (quantized variants ok), ability to fallback to smaller variants for cost-sensitive routes
Features required: streaming responses, function/tool calling, deterministic rollouts, KV/prefix caching, token caps enforcement
Security: SSO (SAML), audit logs for calls, optional EU residency for customer data
Observability: per-route latency and token breakdown, traces tied back to user sessions
poc_details: Scope: integrate Hosted API into 2 onboarding flows (signup guided flow + first-time setup wizard), instrument streaming and function calls
Data: synthetic + sampled anonymized user interactions (no PII in POC), access via short-lived keys
Success metrics: p95 latency < 450ms (end-to-end) for onboarding flows; streaming start < 200ms; average tokens per session < 800; cost per flow within target
Deliverables: integration guide, latency/cost dashboard, recommended batching/quantization profile, failover policy to smaller model
